en: May we obtain here that knowledge which reveals the sun of wisdom, which dispels the darkness of ignorance, and which bestows eternal bliss; may we obtain that knowledge here. ||1||
May we obtain here that knowledge which eliminates wretchedness and suffering, wards off sin and distress, and makes the mind peaceful. 2.
May we obtain here that wisdom which is the cause of liberation, which perceives unity within diversity, and bestows inner clarity. (3)
May we here obtain that wisdom which would eliminate the sense of "I," accomplish the welfare of the entire world, and provide sustenance for the helpless. 4.
May we here obtain that true learning in which the goals of human endeavor, such as dharma and the rest, become meaningful, and in which literacy becomes truly purposeful. (5)
Born of bliss, she who thus fills the entire universe with bliss—may we obtain here that Vidyā which is dissolved in bliss. 6.
